content.rendered:
Welcome back, Archer Glen Families. We are happy to be back from Winter Break and ready to see students and jump back into school.

A few pieces of information and updates:

The AG PAC (Parent Advisory Committee) meeting moved to Jan. 14th at 2:00 pm via Zoom. Please go to their website http://www.archerglenpac.org/ for a Zoom link for the meeting.

The Archer Glen Specials schedule has been revised to include May 31st as a holiday for Memorial Day. This change affects the June A/B schedule. Click HERE for the revised schedule.
